text:
AI providers can block your account at any time. If your team depends on one, that's a real problem 🤔. Nick's post below shows what that actually looks like.

Not a new problem either — companies treated databases as critical ten years ago, but almost nobody rehearsed what to do when one breaks. GitLab learned it in public in 2017:
https://lnkd.in/dzcc_5cv

That's why we're building https://awesome-mcp.xyz — a portable layer over AI vendors, so we can switch when we need to ⚙️.


#EnterpriseAI 
#AIInfrastructure 
#VendorManagement 
#MCP
